ruleDefinitions.name: Potential CobaltStrike Service Installations - Registry
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects known malicious service installs that appear in cases in which a Cobalt Strike beacon elevates privileges or lateral movement.
 Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\System\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Services.*") OR (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\System\\\\ControlSet.*") AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Services.*"))) AND ((Details = RGX(".*ADMIN\\$.*") AND Details = RGX(".*\\\.exe.*")) OR (Details = RGX(".*\\%COMSPEC\\%.*") AND Details = RGX(".*start.*") AND Details = RGX(".*powershell.*"))))
